title: On the Structure of Risk Contribution: A Leave-One-Out Decomposition into Inherent and Correlation Risk
abstract: arXiv:2604.10375v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Risk Contribution (RC) is a widely used risk attribution metric that assigns each position a share of portfolio volatility, with contributions that sum to total portfolio volatility. This paper proposes a leave-one-out decomposition of RC into two interpretable components at the position level: an inherent term (position's own scaled variance) and a correlation term (covariance with the other holdings). Unlike the X-sigma-rho framework, which uses the position's correlation with the full portfolio, ICD uses covariance with the other holdings, yielding qualitatively different diagnostic signals when a position is large relative to the portfolio. The contribution is the interpretive framing and an exact identity linking the components to incremental volatility (iVol), which allows the discrete condition under which a position reduces portfolio volatility to be stated in closed form. translated_title: 论风险贡献的结构：基于留一法的内在风险与相关性风险分解
translated_abstract: 风险贡献是一种广泛使用的风险归因指标，它为每个头寸分配组合波动率中的一个份额，且各头寸的贡献之和等于组合总波动率。本文提出了一种对风险贡献的留一分解方法，在头寸层面将其分解为两个可解释的组成部分：内在项（头寸自身的缩放方差）和相关性项（与其他持仓的协方差）。与X-sigma-rho框架使用头寸与整个组合的相关性不同，ICD使用与其他持仓的协方差，因此当某个头寸相对于组合规模较大时，会产生定性上截然不同的诊断信号。本文的贡献在于解释性框架，以及一个将各组成部分与增量波动率（iVol）相联系的精确恒等式，这使得头寸能够降低组合波动率的离散条件得以用封闭形式表述。该条件与边际条件有所不同……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文提出将风险贡献留一分解为可解释的内在风险与相关性风险两个部分，并通过与增量波动率的精确恒等式，以封闭形式给出了头寸降低组合波动率的离散条件。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a leave-one-out decomposition of Risk Contribution into interpretable inherent and correlation components, and derives an exact identity with incremental volatility that states in closed form the discrete condition under which a position reduces portfolio volatility.
